blocks.text:
The price is per person sharing a DBL room in a 4-star hotel, for a group of 3 guests.

## Trip highlights

Rio introduces you to 2 of the city's main viewpoints. Reach Sugar Loaf by cable car via Urca Hill, then take the train through Tijuca Forest up Corcovado to the statue of Christ the Redeemer.

At Iguazu, excursions cover both the Brazilian and Argentine sides. On the Brazilian side, Macuco Safari and the Bird Park can be booked at an additional cost. The following day, the route explores the Argentine National Park, with walkways and viewing platforms close to the cascades and the Devil's Throat.

The final part of the trip is devoted to Búzios. After the busy sightseeing days, there are 2 full free days to relax on the coast.

## Tour format

Accommodation is in hotels along the route.

Excursions are in a group with an English-speaking guide.

Transfers are in a group with a driver.

Domestic flights Rio de Janeiro – Iguazu – Rio de Janeiro are not included in the tour price. Fares start at US$650.

Additional excursions at Iguazu are also charged separately.
